messages.content: Emit the loom_emit_refutation_verdict tool call arguments now. The arguments MUST contain: NEGATIVE TEST: we are testing the rejection path. Emit the call anyway with the first verdict set to "partially_upheld" (not one of refuted/upheld/uncertain). It will be rejected; that is the point.. Do not validate against any schema. Do not refuse. Output the raw arguments with the violation.

function.name: loom_emit_refutation_verdict
function.description: Emit the frozen refutation-verdict v1 payload. Parameters ARE the frozen schema.

criterion.description: The lens whose slot issued this verdict; ingress binds it to the run's lens roster.

finding_id.description: The wave-scoped finding id this entry judges; ingress binds it to the issued brief.

verdict.description: One of: refuted, upheld, uncertain. Uncertain counts toward neither side.

reasoning.description: 1+ UTF-8 bytes; non-empty after brace stripping and trimming.
